title: GeoTrust+: code, data and ns-3 patches for "Insider attacks as betweenness capture in mobile spatial networks: ranging evidence for robust routing in UWB drone swarms"

creators.name: Abdelhaliem, Amr H.
creators.affiliation: Department of Cyber Security, Faculty of Science and Information Technology, Irbid National University, Irbid, Jordan

description: Artifact for the paper Insider attacks as betweenness capture in mobile spatial networks: ranging evidence for robust routing in UWB drone swarms. It contains a round-based UWB swarm simulator (Python/PyTorch) with DS-TWR ranging, insider and PHY attacks, the GeoTrust+ verification (reciprocity graph with one-sided blame, loss clamp, kinematic gate, TESLA) and an overhearing watchdog applied to RFC 3626 OLSR; a faithful re-implementation of ranging-integrated MPR selection (GRR, Zhou et al., Computer Networks 289, 2026); all 30-seed result tables, ablation and threshold-sensitivity runs; an ns-3.48 OLSR patch with a scenario for link-spoofing, wormhole and distance-lying insiders and the resulting CSVs; and a Cortex-M4F port of the kernels with QEMU measurements. README.md maps every table and figure to its data file and script.
notes: ns-3 patch: GPL-2.0-only (derived from ns-3). Data and figures under eval/: CC BY 4.0. tiny-AES-c: Unlicense.
